Bioc2026 workshop on ontology: working with ontoProc2

Learning objectives

  • Get acquainted with the INCAtools framework for conveying all open biomedical ontologies in a common SQLite structure

  • Program with several ontologies using ontoProc2

  • Understand the role of Model Context Protocol in supporting natural language interrogation of ontologies, and integrate MCP responses with ontoProc2 programming

Background

The INCAtools Semantic SQL project (tutorial notebook) identifies an AWS S3 bucket where a large number of ontologies are available.
